title: Pluto in Enhanced Color
explanation:
# Pluto's Hidden Rainbow

When NASA's New Horizons spacecraft zoomed past Pluto in 2015, it revealed a dwarf planet far more vibrant and geologically complex than anyone expected—its icy surface painted in subtle colors that reveal different chemical compositions, with a famous heart-shaped region split into two strikingly different geological zones. By boosting the color data from the spacecraft's images, scientists transformed faint differences into vivid distinctions, essentially giving us a view of Pluto's true complexity that our eyes could never see on their own.
